observe.description: With a historical step, request physical camera views only and omit history_point_ids; pointcloud views are current-only.

history_point_ids.description: Solved current-observation mark IDs to overlay; omit or pass null for none.

step.description: Saved public observation step in the current round; omit or null for current. Historical selection is read-only and does not rewind the world.

views.description: Selected public views; omit for every physical camera. All current RGB views and calibration are already delivered automatically; use observe for overlays or saved observations.

additional_pairs.description: Optional complementary camera pairs. Observe and segment that same camera at the saved baseline step and current step. Cross-view semantic association is your responsibility.

items.description: One additional same-camera temporal pair for the same Agent-selected object; both observations must equal the primary baseline/current steps.

before_target_ref.description: Target segmented in this camera at the primary before_target_ref's observation step.

current_target_ref.description: The same selected object segmented in the same camera at the current step.

arm.description: Arm whose measured public link6 displacement, applied as a rigid motion, is compared with the target.

before_target_ref.description: The same object's target_ref from an earlier observation in the same round, taken after this arm's gripper was commanded closed and before the motion being tested; a view from before the close is not a valid baseline.

current_target_ref.description: Fresh target localized from the current observation after the small lift.
